results.name: vendor.js --check: the vendored files are untouched by Phase 3
the Phase 3 files are ASCII clean
and every script parses on its own
none of them uses a forbidden API (roundRect, ellipse, confirm, a bare remove)
index.html loads projects, pipeline, unresolved, then studio-boot, in that order
index.html puts the workspace and the unresolved dock side by side in one row, the dock hidden until opened
the pipeline is installed on the shipped page and the Game stage exists beside the four forges
the header has five stages in order: Charter and Rules, Art and Audio, World, Story, Game
a new project: only the Charter is open, the other four are locked, each with its own reason
locked buttons say so to a screen reader and in their tooltip, and the stage on screen is marked current
a click on a locked stage keeps the stage on screen, says why in a toast, and changes nothing in the bundle
the Mark stage Final button says why it cannot be pressed yet (the Charter is not locked), and pressing it refuses without touching the bundle
markFinal on the Charter of a new project refuses with the Charter lock sentence; markFinal on a locked stage and on Game refuse too
the new project has no Final mark on any stage
d146: opens at the charter stage with the right stages unlocked (c:final a:open w:locked s:locked g:locked)
d147: opens at the art stage with the right stages unlocked (c:final a:final w:open s:locked g:locked)
d148: opens at the world stage with the right stages unlocked (c:final a:final w:final s:open g:locked)
demo149: opens at the story stage with the right stages unlocked (c:final a:final w:final s:final g:open)
four149: opens at the story stage with the right stages unlocked (c:final a:final w:final s:final g:open)
a Day 146 Final locks World with the reason that Art and Audio is not Final, and Story with the World reason
no fixture shows a stale stage
the header paints the status chips: Final on four stages and Open on Game for a Day 149 Final
reading the whole pipeline state on the six chapter project takes under 100 ms
the Game stage opens from the header, shows its single Game tab and what Build game will need (four stages Final, nothing unresolved)
Story locks again the moment the World Final mark is gone (draft), with the World reason
Art locks when the Charter is no longer locked even though its own Final mark stands: the previous stage is not ready
Studio.show on a locked stage lands on the furthest stage that is not locked instead of failing
a project opened with its Charter unlocked lands on the Charter stage, not on the stage its Final marks name
a Charter exported only as a Draft leaves the Charter open and Art locked
the button is ready for it: its tooltip names the forge's own checks and says nothing is downloaded
pressing it runs the Charter's own Final: forge 146 final, rules opened, hash stamped, nothing downloaded, and Art unlocks
the note beside the button and the button itself follow: Final, marked today, and Mark Charter Final again
Art and Audio marks Final through its own export (fill on), opens the art namespace, and World unlocks
markFinal leaves the stage on screen where it was (it hopped to Art and back)
Story refuses to be marked Final while its own checks fail, with Day 149's own sentence, and the bundle keeps no Final mark and no opened story
the refusal reaches the person as a toast through the button, and the note says the stage is ready only when it is
after the story is scaffolded, Story marks Final in place: forge 149 final, story opened, hash stamped, nothing downloaded, and Game unlocks
and it is fast enough to be a button (under 5 seconds on the demo project)
the header and note repaint themselves: Story shows Final and the note says so
round trip: the project marked Final in the Studio opens in Days 146, 147, 148 and 149 with the hash verified, no errors, no broken references
a relocked Charter makes Art, World, Story and Game stale, with the version in the sentence; the Charter itself is not
the header shows a Stale badge on those four, their tooltip says why, and the note on the stage on screen leads with it
a stale stage is still open to enter: stale is a badge, not a lock
marking Art Final again clears its badge only; World, Story and Game stay stale
World then Story marked again: every badge clears and Game is open and current
Day 149's own world stamp shows as Stale on Story (and so Game) when the world changes after the story was built, and nowhere else
and Story cannot simply be marked Final again: the story's own check refuses until it is rebuilt on this world
a World that is no longer Final makes Story stale (its predecessor is gone) and locks Game, which needs a Final Story built on a Final World
a Day 149 Final has nothing blocking and nothing owed, but its story checks have not run on this story yet, so it is not called clear
the pending note names the story and offers the Run story checks button
after the story checks run, the same project is clear: nothing blocking, nothing owed, nothing pending
what is left are warnings from the forges' own checks, grouped by namespace in the order Charter, Codex, Rules, Art, World, Story
the header badge reads Clear with the warning count, and its label says what it counts
a reference to a record that does not exist in an opened namespace is BROKEN and blocking: in the Rules group, jumpable, owned by the Charter stage
the dock opens beside the work, does not trap focus or cover the page (no overlay), and lists the broken reference with a Jump button
the badge reports it open, with the blocking count in red
Jump switches to the Charter stage first (the story stage was on screen) and lands on the Charter tab that holds the record; the dock stays open
the dock follows the project: once the reference is fixed the broken row is gone
Close hides the dock, clears the page marker, and the badge says closed
FORWARD stays forward: the same reference while Day 147 has not opened art is owed, not broken; it counts as owed, never as blocking, and sits outside the namespace groups
the project is not clear while something is owed (Build game needs both), but nothing blocks
the owed reference is listed apart, folded away by default, under the stage that owes it
and when Art and Audio opens its namespace the reference stops being owed: Day 147's own fill clears it, so nothing is owed or broken
Kit.jump on a World record from the Charter stage switches to the World stage first (every jump is retargeted, Kit's own validation panel included)
Kit.jump on a Charter record from the Story stage switches back to the Charter stage
Kit.jump toward a locked stage refuses with the reason and moves nothing
an unresolved finding with no record (a whole stage check) opens its stage, and a locked one refuses the same way
the dock is persistent: a page reload brings it back open, on the same project
locked stage buttons never give a bundle the namespace of a stage it has not reached
control: the unlocked Art stage does open and gives the bundle its art namespace, so the gate is not simply switching everything off
switching from a full project to a Day 146 only one does not let a forge's delayed meter repaint fill art, world or story on the new bundle (forge debounces fire only while their stage is live)
native mode (the forges' own suites) is left as it was: the Phase 1 stage bar, no pipeline install, Kit.jump unwrapped, Kit.go not gated
